martha_finch.name: Martha Finch
martha_finch.description: The market warden and unofficial mayor, Martha is a middle-aged woman with straw-blonde hair tucked under a linen cap. She watches over the market and its people with a warm but wary gaze, always polite but never quite revealing what she knows. She is the first to greet newcomers, subtly steering conversations away from local mysteries.

deputy_silas_cragg.name: Deputy Silas Cragg
deputy_silas_cragg.description: A gaunt, sharp-eyed man in a patched uniform, Deputy Silas Cragg acts as the town's unofficial law and the Gravebinders' chief enforcer. He is ever-watchful, wary of strangers, and harbors deep suspicions of anyone poking into the town’s affairs. Cragg is terse, but may offer wary cooperation if convinced the party means no harm.

old_nan_berryman.name: Old Nan Berryman
old_nan_berryman.description: A sprightly old woman with a sharp tongue and a sharper memory. She spins tales for curious listeners, sometimes letting slip more truth than she intends. She is always surrounded by a crowd of townsfolk, eager for her latest story or bit of advice.

ezra_pike.name: Ezra Pike
ezra_pike.description: The chief embalmer, Ezra is a gaunt, hollow-eyed man in his late fifties with a rasping voice and the calm hands of a practiced mortician. He is intensely private but deeply knowledgeable about the fate of Pottsfield’s dead.

widow_elsie_tallow.name: Widow Elsie Tallow
widow_elsie_tallow.description: A gaunt, veiled woman in black, tending a lantern and muttering prayers for the dead. She is both gatekeeper and mourner, fiercely protective of the grounds. Elsie knows much about Pottsfield’s secret rites, but is haunted by memories of loved ones lost (and returned).

specter_of_jonny_harrow.name: Specter of Jonny Harrow
specter_of_jonny_harrow.description: The restless ghost of a Pottsfield villager, bound here by ancient wrongs. He appears mournful, confused, and wary of strangers, but may be convinced to aid those seeking to break the curse.

father_milgrom.name: Father Milgrom
father_milgrom.description: A gaunt, hollow-eyed priest in tattered vestments, bound unwillingly to the altar. He is lucid but despairing, haunted by his failure to stop the Veilwood’s corruption. Milgrom is desperate for absolution and guidance, and holds vital knowledge about the curse—and its undoing.

masked_reveler.name: Masked Reveler
masked_reveler.description: A jovial figure in a patchwork cloak and a carved pumpkin mask, the Masked Reveler is both entertainer and secret-keeper. They organize strange harvest games and encourage newcomers to take part. Beneath their mirth lies a calculating mind, ever watching the crowd for threats to Pottsfield’s order.

bound_spirit.name: Bound Spirit
bound_spirit.description: A translucent, sorrowful apparition is tethered to the central slab by glowing runes. Their form flickers and writhes in distress, unable to speak above a whisper. The spirit gestures desperately toward the sigils, pleading for release.

desperate_townsfolk.name: Desperate Townsfolk
desperate_townsfolk.description: A gaunt villager with haunted eyes, clothing stitched with wilted wildflowers. Their voice trembles as they plead for help, driven nearly mad by grief and fear. They clutch a broken lantern and speak in whispers about the 'sleeping beneath.'

freed_spirits.name: Freed Spirits
freed_spirits.description: A chorus of faint, shimmering figures—villagers lost to the Parish curse—rise here if the Bound Spirit from the Stillhouse was released. They are grateful, speaking in riddles and blessing the party, but warn of a greater malignancy deeper within.

cold_start.summary: Party enters Pottsfield with no prior continuity context. Present the silent harvest atmosphere and immediate stakes clearly.

partial_context.summary: Party enters Pottsfield with some prior context. Establish the village's strange customs before branch-critical revelations.

late_arc.summary: Party arrives at Pottsfield in late-arc state. Provide compact setup and maintain path to a valid resolution of the burial curse.

cross_module_refs.notes: Martha Finch handoff thread links Pottsfield mysteries to The Thornwood Watch.

standalone_fallback.notes: A_Pottsfield_Burial remains fully playable as a standalone module.
